products.name: FixAi
products.heroTitle: Smarter Home Maintenance, Powered by AI
products.heroDescription: FixAi helps homeowners track appliances, stay ahead of maintenance, and troubleshoot problems using AI — all in one simple place.
heroPoints: Understand issues before they become expensive repairs
Keep appliance details, manuals, and history organized
Get AI guidance in plain English, anytime
problemParagraphs: Most homeowners don't ignore maintenance — they simply don't have a system.
Maintenance schedules get forgotten. Appliance manuals disappear. Problems are noticed only when something breaks.
By the time you act, the cost is already higher — and the stress is unavoidable.
FixAi was built to change that.
products.platformTitle: One intelligent platform for your entire home
products.platformDescription: FixAi brings appliance tracking, maintenance reminders, and AI-powered help together — so you always know what to do next.

capabilities.title: Add Your Home
capabilities.description: Create a digital profile of your home in seconds. Everything FixAi does is tailored to your space.

capabilities.title: Track Appliances Automatically
capabilities.description: Store appliance type, model, history, and maintenance needs in one place — no spreadsheets or notes.

capabilities.title: AI-Powered Guidance
capabilities.description: Ask questions, describe issues, or get step-by-step help without technical jargon.

capabilities.title: Prevent Problems Early
capabilities.description: Timely reminders help you act before minor issues turn into costly repairs.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.description: Sign up and start with your home.

steps.title: Add appliances
steps.description: FixAi helps you organize everything quickly and accurately.

steps.title: Let AI assist you
steps.description: From maintenance reminders to troubleshooting, FixAi guides you every step of the way.

products.aiKicker: AI that actually understands your home
products.aiTitle: Built specifically for homeowners — not generic chatbots
products.aiDescription: Instead of overwhelming you with information, FixAi tells you what matters, why it matters, and what to do next.

aiFeatures.title: Routine Maintenance
aiFeatures.description: FixAi reminds you when filters, inspections, or upkeep are due — before performance drops.

aiFeatures.title: Unexpected Issues
aiFeatures.description: Strange noise? Poor performance? Ask FixAi and get clear guidance instantly.

aiFeatures.title: Appliance Organization
aiFeatures.description: Model numbers, manuals, and service history — always available when you need them.

aiFeatures.title: Peace of Mind
aiFeatures.description: Know your home is being maintained properly without constantly thinking about it.

products.ctaTitle: Protect one of your biggest investments with FixAi
products.ctaDescription: Your home is one of your biggest investments. FixAi helps you protect it intelligently.
products.ctaNote: Free to start. Takes only a few minutes.

Reduce electricity bills with residential and commercial solar
Build with quality-first engineering and durable components
Deploy nationwide with trusted execution across India
samagraProduct.platformDescription: Samagra Enterprises provides end-to-end solar energy solutions across India with engineering precision, reliable delivery, and long-term performance in every installation.

capabilities.title: Residential Solar
capabilities.description: Cut your electricity bills by up to 90% with custom-designed rooftop solar systems for your home.

capabilities.title: Commercial Solar
capabilities.description: High-capacity solar EPC solutions tailored for factories, hospitals, and educational institutions.

capabilities.title: Industrial EPC

capabilities.title: Price Calculator
capabilities.description: Get a fast estimate using monthly bill and roof area before you schedule your consultation.

samagraProduct.aiTitle: Built For Performance and Long-Term Reliability
samagraProduct.aiDescription: From premium components to large-scale execution, Samagra Enterprises delivers quality solar systems engineered to perform for years across homes, institutions, and industrial projects.

aiFeatures.title: Solar Panels
aiFeatures.description: High-efficiency mono-PERC modules for residential and commercial rooftops with a 25-year warranty.

aiFeatures.title: Solar Inverters
aiFeatures.description: Advanced grid-tie and hybrid smart inverters with mobile monitoring and a 10-year warranty.

aiFeatures.title: Solar Water Heaters
aiFeatures.description: Durable, high-capacity systems for reliable hot water performance in all weather conditions.

aiFeatures.title: Trusted By Industry Leaders
